scientific_integrity: The sign classification is analytic: the two support regimes have explicit formulas, each derivative has at most one sign change by a strictly monotone likelihood-type ratio, and Mills bounds control the junction and tail. The bundled computation only reproduces root brackets and sample signs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the all-radius central-mass comparison only for the standardized shape-one Gamma law. It does not assert the number or location of crossings for other Gamma shapes. The crossover decimals are evaluations of uniquely characterized roots, and bibliographic search cannot exclude an equivalent elementary calculation under unrelated terminology.
title: Exactly two Gaussian central-mass crossings for the standardized exponential
